text:
Nora Li: quick question for the style guide: should we treat model IDs (like `gpt-x`) as code spans everywhere or plain text? i lean code spans so they stand out in prose.
Samira: code spans for inline, code blocks for examples. helps ppl copy/paste. add a note in voice doc: 'wrap identifiers and CLI flags in backticks'.
docs-bot: Reminder: style doc PR assigned to @Samira for review.
Kenji Tanaka: also add a note about capitalization: use 'Redwood Inference' on first mention in docs; after that 'Redwood' is fine. product names should be Title Case.
Nora Li: ok will add both notes. also adding a tiny section: 'when to call something deprecated' with suggested wording: "This parameter is deprecated and will be removed on YYYY-MM-DD. Use `model` instead." keep it factual.
Samira: perfect. small nit: avoid future-tense fluff like "we will". use imperative or present simple.
Nora Li: got it. i'll push the PR update this afternoon.
